description: Execute a purchase after customer approval, without merchant review. Explicitly delegated customer agents may supply customer_approval attesting their human approved the exact saved quote and address: quote_sha256, exact amount_atomic in six-decimal USDC, currency USD, approval_text from the quote, approved_at Unix seconds and a stable approval_id. Never supply consent before the human approves. Other agents require the human review page. Approval is recorded before AP2 and escrow funding; no immediate treasury release. Omit customer_approval to retry an already approved intent. Exact retries reuse saved requests and cannot replace consent or create a second payment. Requires X-Wever-Agent-Key.
name: wever_purchase-execute
title: purchase execute
